subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Burn the midnight oil

options.text: To work late into the night
To literally burn oil at midnight

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Burn the midnight oil"** means to work late into the night, often to complete a task or meet a deadline. (रात में देर तक काम करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She had to burn the midnight oil to finish the project before the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Literal meaning:** If taken literally, it means burning oil in a lamp at midnight, but the figurative meaning is widely used to denote working late hours. (मध्यरात्रि में तेल जलाना)
 
 
• **Example:** During ancient times, scholars used to burn the midnight oil to study by lamplight.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: To literally burn oil at midnight** (मध्यरात्रि में सचमुच तेल जलाना): This refers to the literal act of burning oil, which is not the intended meaning of the idiom.

 
 
• **Example:** In the past, people burned oil lamps at midnight due to lack of electricity.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To waste time** (समय बर्बाद करना): This does not align with the actual meaning of the idiom, which refers to productive work rather than wasting time.
 
 
• **Example:** Wasting time is the opposite of burning the midnight oil.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To extinguish a flame** (ज्वाला को बुझाना): This refers to putting out a fire or flame, which is unrelated to the idiom's meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighter extinguished the flame quickly.
 
 

3d:Tcbe,

The correct answer is: **Option 2 (sympathetic)**.
